evidence_boundary: Candidate sequence IDs are review queue identifiers only. They are not video, scene, capture-session or physical-sign ground truth and cannot authorize a split or training.

assumptions: 1-3 minutes per strong candidate sequence using a contact sheet
estimate excludes creator contact and taxonomy adjudication

review_workflow: Review each strong sequence as a contact sheet and split it when scene/sign identity changes.
Review every uncertain edge pair and decide join, split, or needs-source-metadata.
Spot-check adjacency-only boundaries for missed gradual transitions.
Record reviewer, date, decision, evidence and confidence; never copy proxy IDs into final group_id automatically.
Create final group-aware split only after all accepted groups are adjudicated.
